blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Yvon Bisera bounced back like she promised and closed out with a five-under-par 67 to finish in the top 10 of the Kenda Tires TLPGA Open ruled by local ace Yu Chiang Hou via a dramatic three-way playoff at Taichung International Golf Club in Taiwan on Friday. Bisera, whose second round 73 snuffed her title chances, finished with a nine-under 207 total and easily became the highest Filipino finisher in talented field that disputed NT$4 million in prize money.
